messages:
katie-events: Heads-up 1: final checklist for 'Benchmarking LLM Inference' webinar next Tue. Need: reg page fields, calendar link, Zoom cohosts, recording + transcript policy, and lead routing mapping.

oliver-growth: Reg page: name, work email, company, role, and a single-use-case dropdown (Prod, Research, Dev Tools, Other). Add hidden UTM fields (utm_source, utm_campaign). Keep it short to keep conversion high.

maria-marketing: Add consent checkbox: 'Send me the recording + related content'. I'll prepare 24h + 72h follow-up copy. Also propose a 1-question micro-survey in the 72h email.

sam-martech: Routing plan: registration webhook -> enrich -> create lead in Marketo. Map fields and set tag source=webinar; if role contains "Engineer" or company_size >50 -> tag high-intent for SFDC AE queue. Low intent -> automated nurture. Mapping: form.email -> Email, form.name -> FullName, hidden.utm_campaign -> Campaign.

katie-events: Zoom config: cloud recording ON, audio transcript ON, auto-start recording. Co-hosts: oliver-growth, maria-marketing. Retention: recordings auto-delete after 90 days unless flagged by compliance. Allow host to unmute for demo Q&A.

oliver-growth: I'll prep a 1-slide CTA for the end that links to the estimate form. Also please tag leads with campaign=benchmark-apr2026.

sam-martech: I'll build the Zap: Marketo lead creation + SFDC upsert + Slack alert to #sales-inbox for high-intent. Will test with test+webinar@redwood.test and report back in ~90 minutes.

zoom-bot: Reminder: Event 'Redwood Benchmarking' Tue 2026-04-28 15:00 UTC. Recording: cloud recording ON, Transcription: ON.

maria-marketing: 24h email draft: "Hi {{first_name}}, thanks for attending! Recording: <link>. Quick recap + 90s survey: <link>. Want a tailored cost/latency estimate? Reply and we'll book 15m."

katie-events: Great. Action items: Maria finalize email copy and survey link; Sam run registration QA and confirm Slack alert; Oliver prepare slide CTA; I'll publish reg page with hidden UTMs and calendar link.

sam-martech: On it 1. Will post QA results in this thread.
